name: Manufacturing
description: Safety boards, production KPIs, shift information and plant notices for factories and workshops.

templates.name: Days Since Last Incident
templates.description: The safety counter every plant entrance needs.

elements.text: Our best run on record is 212 days. Look after each other and we will beat it.
REPORT EVERY HAZARD - NO JOB IS WORTH AN INJURY

templates.name: Life-Saving Rules
templates.description: Six non-negotiable safety rules as numbered steps.

elements.text: Hard hat, safety glasses and steel toes past the yellow line.
No energy source stays live while you work on a machine.
Never bypass an interlock or run with a guard removed.
Stay in the walkways and make eye contact with every driver.
Harness and lanyard for all work at height. Every time.
Anyone can stop unsafe work. Nobody will be questioned for it.
BREAKING A LIFE-SAVING RULE IS THE ONLY WAY TO GET SENT HOME

templates.name: PPE Required
templates.description: Portrait door poster listing mandatory protective equipment.

elements.text: Safety glasses, hi-vis vest, hearing protection and steel-toe boots. No exceptions, visitors included.
PPE STORE - BAY 2, NEXT TO THE TIME CLOCKS

templates.name: Lockout / Tagout Steps
templates.description: The six-step isolation procedure at the machine.

elements.text: Tell the line lead and everyone working on the machine.
Use the normal stop sequence, never the emergency stop.
Electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, steam and stored gravity energy.
Your own padlock and your own name on every isolation point.
Bleed lines, block rams and discharge capacitors before you start.
Try to start it. No movement means it is safe.
ONE LOCK PER PERSON - NEVER REMOVE SOMEONE ELSE PADLOCK

templates.name: Emergency Assembly Point
templates.description: Portrait evacuation notice with the muster point.

elements.text: Leave by the nearest fire exit. Walk to the car park flagpole. Wait for the roll call.
DO NOT RE-ENTER UNTIL A FIRE MARSHAL SAYS SO

templates.name: Toolbox Talk Topic
templates.description: Photo split announcing the daily pre-shift talk.

elements.text: Five minutes at the line before start-up. Pinch points, glove choice and safe tool handling.

templates.name: Report a Near Miss
templates.description: Loud reporting prompt with a scannable form link.

elements.text: Log it in under a minute. No names, no blame, no comeback.
EVERY REPORT STOPS THE NEXT INJURY

templates.name: Forklift Traffic Warning
templates.description: High-contrast warning for shared pedestrian routes.

elements.text: Stay inside the green walkway. Stop at every crossing. Make eye contact before you step out.
PEDESTRIAN PRIORITY - DRIVERS GIVE WAY AT ALL CROSSINGS

elements.text: Report to reception, watch the four-minute induction and collect your badge and safety glasses.

templates.name: Safety Pledge Quote

elements.text: No part, no order and no deadline is worth your hands.

templates.name: Shift Handover Checklist
templates.description: Six things every outgoing lead hands over.

elements.text: Outgoing and incoming leads, five minutes, machine by machine.
Output, scrap and OEE against plan for the shift.
Anything degraded, on a temporary fix or waiting on parts.
Batches on hold, open concessions and any customer complaint.
Stock at the line, incoming deliveries and short kits.
Both leads sign. No signature means no handover.
HANDOVER LOG LIVES ON THE LINE 4 TERMINAL

templates.name: Hygiene at the Line
templates.description: Five hygiene rules for entry into clean production areas.

elements.text: Twenty seconds with soap and water at the entry sinks.
Full cover before you cross the blue line.
Plain wedding band only. Lockers are in the changing room.
Stomach upset or a skin infection keeps you off the line.
Every break, every washroom visit, every glove change.
SPOT CHECKS RUN DAILY ON ALL PRODUCTION ENTRANCES
